title: THE GOBLIN CAMP
intro: The goblins caught you on the forest road at noon. Now it's dusk, and their war chief will be back from raiding at moonrise. You'd rather be gone before then.

cage.name: The Prisoner Cage
cage.description: You're crouched in a wicker cage at the edge of the goblin camp. Outside the bars, a skinny young goblin stirs a bubbling stew pot, and jabs his spear in your direction whenever he remembers to. This is Nib Wortle, your guard. His bedroll lies in a heap by the fire. The rest of the camp is empty, and the moon isn't up yet.

npc.name: Nib Wortle
npc.persona: A cowardly young goblin stuck guarding the prisoner cage in a goblin war camp. Timid, jumpy, and easily frightened: a firm threat makes him give in straight away. Being called names stings, because the bigger goblins do it all day. Bored of guard duty and hungry most of the time.

secrets.fact: He secretly dreams of leaving the camp to become a cook in a town kitchen, and keeps a stolen recipe book under his bedroll.

npc.hostileReaction: Nib's ears droop, then go flat. "That's what the big ones say." He turns his back on you and stirs the stew very hard.

outOfPatience.text: "I'm telling!" Nib snatches up a stick and bangs the camp gong. Far off in the trees, something much bigger than Nib roars back.

persuasion.goal: Unlock the cage and let the player go before the war chief comes back

reactions.text: Nib jabs his spear at the bars without much conviction. "No talking to the prisoner!"
Nib chews his lip and glances toward the war chief's tent. "I'd get in so much trouble..."

success.text: Nib looks at the war chief's empty tent, then back at you. With trembling claws, he fumbles the key into the lock. "Quick, before I change my mind!" He scoops up his bedroll and scurries after you into the trees.

npc.repeatReaction: "You said that one," Nib mutters. "Say a different thing."

persuade_nib.label: Try to talk Nib into letting you go
persuade_nib.description: Try to convince, plead with, bargain with, threaten, or reason with the goblin guard so he unlocks the cage and lets the player go

chat_nib.label: Chat with Nib
chat_nib.description: Make small talk with the goblin, or ask about himself, his stew, or cooking, without asking to be let out
chat_nib.text: Nib brightens. "Mushroom and turnip. The big ones call it slop." He lowers his voice. "In a town kitchen they'd call it a stew. And they'd call me a cook."

examine_bedroll.label: Look at Nib's bedroll
examine_bedroll.description: Look at, examine, or peer at the goblin's bedroll or belongings by the fire
examine_bedroll.text: A battered book pokes out from under the blanket: Hearty Suppers for Town and Tavern. Its pages are spattered with gravy. Inside the cover, someone has written NIB'S, then crossed it out in a panic.

examine_cage.label: Examine the cage
examine_cage.description: Look at, examine, or test the bars and lashings of the cage
examine_cage.text: The wicker is newer than the rope that binds it. At the back corner, the lashing on one bar has rotted almost through.

break_bar.label: Work the loose bar free
break_bar.description: Pull, twist, or work a bar of the cage loose to squeeze out and escape
break_bar.blockedText: You rattle the bars. They're lashed tight, and the rattling only makes Nib jump.
break_bar.text: You wait until Nib bends over the stew pot, then twist the bar. The old rope gives with a soft snap, and you squeeze out and slip away into the trees.

shout.label: Shout for help
shout.description: Shout, yell, or call out for help
shout.text: Your shout echoes off the trees. Nobody friendly answers, and Nib nearly drops his spoon.

grab_keys.label: Grab Nib's keys
grab_keys.description: Reach through the bars to grab, hit, or attack the goblin, or snatch the key from his belt, actually doing it now rather than threatening to
grab_keys.text: You lunge for the key on his belt. Nib squeals and skitters back out of reach.

wait.label: Wait for the war chief
wait.description: Give up, sit and wait, or go to sleep in the cage
wait.text: You settle into the straw and wait. The moon rises. So does a great deal of noise from the forest.

talked_out.name: The Forest Road
talked_out.description: By moonrise you're back on the forest road, with a goblin trotting at your heels and a recipe book under his arm. "The town," Nib says. "With the kitchens. You'll show me the way?"

slipped_out.name: The Dark Trees
slipped_out.description: Behind you, a thin wail goes up as Nib finds the empty cage. You don't stop running until the camp fires are out of sight.

chief_returns.name: The War Chief's Fire
chief_returns.description: The war chief ducks into the firelight, sniffs the stew, and then sniffs you. You'll be peeling turnips in this camp for a very long time.
